episodesIntro: Welcome. So glad you made it!

How do you start dating again after years in a relationship? What do you do when you still love someone, but you no longer want that relationship? And how do you take care of love when you have a thousand other things on your plate?
That's what we talk about on Love Mode. Sometimes from my own experience, sometimes with guests and experts. And sometimes, just you and me.

home.welcomeTitle: Your little corner of love on the internet
welcomeParagraphs: Into someone, but modern dating feels like it needs a manual? Haven't been on a first date in years and don't even know where to start? The relationship is over and you're struggling to let go? Love your life and also want someone to share a Sunday with? In a relationship and discovering that loving each other is only one part of it?
I got ya! That's what we talk about on Love Mode. Meeting someone, saying goodbye, trying again, and taking care of what we want to last.
I'm Andrea Moreno, journalist, podcast host, and your love & dating bestie. I've fallen in love, I've gotten divorced, and I've bet on love again.

Ever since I was little, I've been the go-to for heart advice, the matchmaker. And here I am, years later, talking about love, trying to figure it out, and asking questions that end up becoming Love Mode episodes.
Wherever you are on your love journey, you've got company here.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Your trust matters most to Love Mode. Here's what data I collect when you visit lovemodepod.com, what I use it for, who I share it with and what rights you have.

sections.heading: Who is responsible for your data
sections.body: Love Mode is Andrea Moreno's podcast, based in Miami, Florida (United States). For any question about your data, write to me at andrea@lovemodepod.com.

sections.heading: What I collect and why
sections.body:
- Newsletter: your name (if you give it), your email and the topics you choose, to send you the emails you asked for. I only write to you after you confirm your subscription.
- WhatsApp (optional, on the "This is just the beginning" page): your phone number, only if you give it and tick the consent box, to send you Love Mode messages on WhatsApp. You can ask me to stop at any time.
- "Share your story" form: your name, email, social media and what you tell me, to consider your story and contact you if it fits an episode.
- "For brands" form: your name or company, email, website, type of collaboration, budget and idea, to reply to your proposal.
- Paid calls and email replies: your name, email, what you tell me and the payment details, to provide the service. Calls are booked on Cal.com; payments are processed by Stripe, and I never see your card details.
- Visits to the site: anonymous, aggregated statistics (pages viewed, country, device type and loading speed) to understand what works and improve the site. They use no cookies and don't identify you.

sections.heading: Why I'm allowed to use it
sections.body: I use your data because you give me your consent (newsletter and WhatsApp), because you send it to me so I can reply (forms), because it's needed to provide a service you paid for (calls and emails), or because of my legitimate interest in keeping the site secure and understanding how it's used (statistics). You can withdraw your consent at any time.

sections.heading: Who I share it with
sections.body:
I don't sell or rent your data. It's only used by the services that run this site, each for its own job:

- Kit (kit.com): sends the newsletter.
- Sanity (sanity.io): stores the messages from the forms.
- Resend (resend.com): emails me when a form comes in.
- Stripe (stripe.com): processes payments.
- Cal.com (cal.com): handles bookings and video calls.
- Vercel (vercel.com): hosts the site and produces the anonymous statistics.
- YouTube: episode images load from YouTube, which may receive your IP address.

These services are based in the United States, so your data may be processed outside your country, with the safeguards each provider offers.

sections.heading: How long I keep it
sections.body: Newsletter data and your WhatsApp number, until you unsubscribe or ask me to delete them. Form messages, as long as needed to reply to you and for 24 months at most. Stories from paid calls and emails, for 12 months at most after I reply; payment records, as long as tax law requires.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body:
At any time you can ask me to show, correct or delete your data, object to or limit how I use it, or get a copy. Write to me at andrea@lovemodepod.com and I'll reply within 30 days.

To leave the newsletter, use the link at the bottom of every email.

If you live in the European Union and think I haven't handled your data properly, you can complain to your country's data protection authority.

sections.heading: Children
sections.body: This site isn't aimed at children under 16, and I don't knowingly collect children's data.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
sections.body: If I change this policy, I'll update the date above. If the change is important and you're on the newsletter, I'll let you know by email.

terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.intro: These terms apply to the paid calls and email replies offered by Love Mode. By booking or paying, you accept them.

sections.heading: Who offers the service
sections.body: Love Mode is Andrea Moreno's podcast, based in Miami, Florida (United States). For any question, write to andrea@lovemodepod.com.

sections.heading: What each service includes
sections.body:
- A call with your love bestie: 30 minutes by video call, US$65. Booked and paid on Cal.com.
- Tell me by email: you send me your story, up to 600 words, and I reply by email within 3 business days, US$35. Paid with Stripe.

sections.heading: What it isn't
sections.body:
I share my opinion from my personal experience and as a journalist who talks about love and relationships. I'm not a psychologist or therapist, and these services aren't therapy or a substitute for a mental health, medical or legal professional.

If you're in danger or in crisis, call 911 in the United States or your country's emergency number.

sections.heading: Payments
sections.body: Payments are processed by Stripe, directly or through Cal.com. Love Mode never sees or stores your card details. Prices are in US dollars; your bank may charge a currency conversion fee.

sections.heading: Cancellations and refunds
sections.body:
- Call: if you cancel at least 24 hours before, you get a full refund. If you cancel later or don't show up, there's no refund. You can reschedule from your confirmation email.
- Email: if you change your mind before I reply, write to me and I'll refund you. Once my reply is sent, there's no refund.
- If for any reason I can't provide the service, you get a full refund.

sections.heading: Privacy
sections.body: Your story is private. I don't share it on Love Mode or my social media without your explicit permission. The privacy policy explains what data I keep and for how long.

sections.heading: Changes
sections.body: I may update these terms. The date above shows the latest version; bookings and payments already made keep the terms you accepted.
